subject.title: fix(cron): expose flat cron job fields and normalize malformed tool args

question: Should the cron agent tool permanently advertise flat `model`, `fallbacks`, and `toolsAllow` inputs and normalize their recoverable scalar forms before validation?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound and live-proven, but it makes provider routing and runtime tool filtering more prominent through a duplicated model-facing contract and increases every sampled Codex tool prompt.

options.title: Accept the flat contract
options.body: Approve the provider-compatible flat schema and canonicalization with the current shell-field rejection and focused coverage.

options.title: Narrow sensitive fields
options.body: Keep flat schedule and message recovery but require `model`, `fallbacks`, and `toolsAllow` to remain nested payload inputs.

options.title: Redesign the schema
options.body: Pause this branch and pursue another provider-compatible schema strategy without the duplicate flat surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the flat contract
recommendation.body: Approve the provider-compatible flat schema and canonicalization with the current shell-field rejection and focused coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest available combined history around cron, Gateway, and security-sensitive agent behavior for deciding the permanent contract.
